svg.desc: Small-multiple histograms, simulation. Age table (40 cm): 49.4% within ±0.25 D, 0.0% given no pair; Age table + measured distance: 42.2% within ±0.25 D, 5.8% given no pair; Rack card at 14 in: 47.2% within ±0.25 D, 5.7% given no pair; Rack card where they read: 46.7% within ±0.25 D, 3.8% given no pair; Small Print start: 58.7% within ±0.25 D, 7.5% given no pair; Small Print + try-on (0.50 stock): 71.8% within ±0.25 D, 8.4% given no pair; Small Print + try-on (0.25 stock): 74.0% within ±0.25 D, 8.2% given no pair.
svg.text: Distribution of chosen minus ideal strength (D) for simulated in-scope people. Left of 0 = too weak, right = too strong.
